messages:
cass: noticed a bug — when opening a model flyout focus moves into the panel but NVDA doesn't read the panel header. focus lands on first tabbable control (close button) but no announcement. anyone else? noor: likely focus management — we set focus programmatically to the panel container (div with role='dialog') but didn't give it a proper accessible name. screen readers need role=dialog with aria-labelledby or aria-label on the panel itself, or move focus to the first focusable with an accessible name. ben: also check aria-hidden toggles — when dialog opens we hide main content with aria-hidden="true". if that's not applied consistently NVDA might still read background. ensure inert or aria-hidden on siblings. noor: NVDA/Firefox expects the dialog to be focusable and have an accessible name. sample: ```

Model GPT-9 details

...
``` On open, set focus to the dialog or the heading and ensure body siblings get aria-hidden. cass: good point. we were moving focus to the close button but didn't announce the title. moving focus to heading fixes VO too. a11y-bot: automated scan: dialog missing aria-modal or accessible name. Created issue A11Y-900. ben: another nit: on close, restore focus to the originating card and ensure focus ring is visible. current restore is to document body which confuses keyboard users. store the opener before opening and restore focus on close. noor: for live region announcements inside flyout (status updates), use aria-live="polite" and avoid announcing on every input. debounce to 300ms and limit to critical status changes. cass: color/contrast note: the flyout close button's focus outline on dark theme is 3.0:1. need 4.5:1. ryan from design suggested increasing stroke thickness and using --focus-high token. filing ticket. cass: ok i'll apply fixes: add aria-labelledby, aria-modal, aria-hidden siblings, focus restore, and tweak contrast. will push a PR and attach NVDA/VO test notes. ping when demo attached. noor: thanks — include keyboard test cases in PR: open via keyboard, tab through, close with Esc, focus returns to opener. ben: i'll validate on VoiceOver and NVDA once PR is up. :thumbsup:
